transcript: People think reading books is only for information, but in the old way, a real book is not something you read, it is something that reads you back. A true book shows you the parts of yourself you have been too busy to sit with. It slows your breath, softens your thoughts, and brings your spirit back into balance. When you read with presence, your nervous system calms, your heart becomes steady, and your inner world becomes quiet enough for wisdom to enter. Do not read to finish, do not rush like the modern world, read like you sip warm tea, slow, gentle, allowing every word to nourish your soul. And if you don't know where to begin, I placed a simple healing book for you in the link on my profile. Start there, read one page a day, and let it walk beside you like an old friend.
